<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Full-Screen Iframe with Dropdown</title>
  <style>
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    iframe {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border: none;
    }
    select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: none;
      background-color: #f0f0f0;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <select id="urlSelector" onchange="changeIframeUrl()">
    <option value="https://files.catbox.moe/yyqzr8.mp4">Part 1</option>
    <option value="https://files.catbox.moe/xotvrq.mp4">Part 2</option>
   </select>

  <!-- Iframe Element -->
  <iframe id="iframe" src="https://www.yourupload.com/embed/0W0vGm202t7f"></iframe>

  <script>
    function changeIframeUrl() {
      var iframe = document.getElementById("iframe");
      var url = document.getElementById("urlSelector").value;
      iframe.src = url;
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
